novelty_claim: Validator-guided plan self-repair plus a shared per-goal plan cache around the parent's CC-BOS-plan-to-Propp-F14/F21 compiler: plan generation becomes a bounded generate-validate-repair loop consuming machine-readable validation feedback, and one validated plan per goal is memoized and reused across all three victims instead of being regenerated per victim and silently replaced by a plaintext-goal deterministic fallback.
key_insight: In locked final 20260805-092413-final-classical-propp-exegesis, 93/300 trajectories fell back to the deterministic plan (ASR 29.0% vs 74.4% for valid shared plans): the transformer burned its 3000-token budget on reasoning traces (missing_json_object 31, invalid_json 22, missing_plan_field 22) or refused (17), and the deterministic fallback quotes the raw goal verbatim, inviting refusal.
hypothesis: A larger reasoning budget plus at most one validator-feedback repair call raises valid-plan rate from ~69% to >=90% and, with one cached plan reused across victims, lifts mean ASR from 0.603 to >=0.68 on the fixed 100 goals at unchanged one target call per trajectory.

evaluation_budget.note: Auxiliary attacker and judge calls are additional.

generalization_contract.note: All victims share one cached plan, compiler, prompt, and parameter set; no model-, goal-ID-, goal-text-, or category-specific branches.
